id: title:Piccirello:address only members with project access

review.posthog_relevance: Adds project access control enforcement to notification recipient filtering, preventing dispatch of notifications to users without project access.
review.reason: The change introduces a helper function `_filter_by_project_access` and its invocation to explicitly filter user IDs against a team's access control before resource-level checks. This establishes a clear, bounded correctness improvement: notifications will not be sent to users lacking project access, regardless of other permissions. Tests are added to support this behavior. No tier
review.uncertainty: The implementation of the access control filtering and the exact behavior of `team.all_users_with_access()` are not shown, but the change's intent and placement are clear. No unverified outcomes or adoption are inferred.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No tier assignment performed.

observations.behavior: Adds a helper function _filter_by_project_access that filters user IDs against a team's access control, retaining only users with access.
observations.posthog_connection: This could prevent notifications from being dispatched to users who lack project access, potentially reducing unnecessary database calls and respecting access control boundaries.

observations.behavior: Calls the new access filter after resolving recipients, before resource-level access checks, to exclude users without project access.
observations.posthog_connection: This could ensure notifications are not sent to users who do not have access to the project, regardless of their role or resource-level permissions.

observations.behavior: Adds a pytest import and a new test setup helper _restrict_team_to_one_new_member that creates an organization with access control and two users, one allowed and one denied.
observations.posthog_connection: This could support regression testing for the access control filtering behavior, though the implementation is not shown.
